name: The Light Afraid of the Dark

prologue.title: Alone with the Lighthouse
prologue.narrator: Some nights, the world whispers just loudly enough for you to hear.
prologue.text:
Tonight, Grandpa Loran has gone fishing out at sea, and for the first time, you are the one keeping watch over the Cape Mist lighthouse.

Aikito, your curious little dog, trots at your side, nose lifted to the air.

You climb the spiral staircase, a lantern in your hand.

Through the window, the sea is black and calm.

Then, far out on the water, a blue-green glow appears, trembling, like a star fallen into the waves.

A deep, sorrowful cry cuts through the night.

Aikito freezes, ears pricked.

*"That is not a boat."*

{{player}}, your heart beats faster.

choices.text: Go down and take the rowboat to see
Look first through the lighthouse spyglass

observation.title: The Spyglass
observation.narrator: Looking before you act is not being afraid — it is learning to understand.
observation.text:
You set down the lantern and grab Grandpa Loran's spyglass.

Aikito rises on his hind legs against the windowsill, trying to see too.

Through the lens, the glow grows clearer: a round shape, almost soft, blinking at intervals.

One long blink. Two short ones. Another long one.

*"It looks like it's talking to us,"* Aikito breathes, head tilted.

Your heart settles a little. Whatever shines out there does not look like a monster. It looks like someone calling for help.

choices.text: Answer with the lighthouse light
Go straight down to the beach

signal.title: A Message of Light
signal.narrator: Speaking a language you do not yet know often begins with a blink of light.
signal.text:
You work the lighthouse mechanism. Long. Short. Short.

The glow on the water stops still.

Then it answers: three quick flashes, like a little laugh.

It drifts closer to the rocks, gently, as if it has finally found someone who listens.

Aikito wags his tail, already ready to go down.

*"Come on, come on, come on!"*

choices.text: Go down to meet the Lumignon
Keep the light conversation going a little longer

dialogue_lumiere.title: Learning to Blink
dialogue_lumiere.narrator: Sometimes, understanding begins by repeating the same gesture until it becomes a bridge.
dialogue_lumiere.text:
You mimic the blinks again. Long. Short. Short.

The glow answers with a new pattern: two flashes, a pause, then a longer one.

Aikito tilts his head.

*"I think it's saying thank you. Or maybe it's scared. Maybe both."*

When you finally go down the stairs, you feel the creature is already waiting by the rocks, less trembling than before.

choices.text: Join the creature on the beach

plage.title: What Shines in the Water
plage.narrator: The dark hides as many fears as wonders — the only difference is who dares to look.
plage.text:
Cold sand crunches beneath your feet. Aikito trots ahead, then stops short.

Near the rocks, the glow floats on the surface: a small sea creature, covered in scales that shine like wet stars.

It has large dark eyes and two long glowing antennae that tremble.

The moment it sees you, it half-dives, ready to flee.

Aikito sits slowly in the sand, as if to show he is not dangerous.

It is smaller than you. And it looks just as frightened as the two of you.

choices.text: Stay still and speak softly
Step back, startled

peur_reaction.title: A Step Backward
peur_reaction.narrator: Being afraid is not a bad thing. What matters is what you do right after.
peur_reaction.text:
You step back without meaning to.

The creature startles and vanishes beneath the water in a flash of light.

Aikito nudges your leg with his nose.

*"It's okay, it's okay... it was just as scared as you."*

You feel a little foolish. It had done nothing wrong — it had only cried out, the way you call when you are lost.

A faint shimmer reappears, a little farther off, hesitant.

choices.text: Apologize in a whisper and stay calm this time
Wait patiently without moving

creature_revient.title: A Second Chance
creature_revient.narrator: Trust is rebuilt slowly, like a tide coming back in.
creature_revient.text:
The glow draws near again, more slowly.

The creature keeps its distance, but does not leave.

It watches Aikito most of all, still and silent for once.

You sit down in the sand, to seem smaller, less frightening.

Little by little, it glides to the water's edge, right in front of you.

choices.text: Gently reach out your hand
Softly sing one of Grandpa Loran's lullabies

berceuse_plage.title: A Voice in the Night
berceuse_plage.narrator: A familiar melody can comfort two beings at once: the one who sings and the one who listens.
berceuse_plage.text:
You murmur the old lullaby Grandpa Loran used to hum when you were afraid of thunder.

The creature stops trembling. Its light pulses to the rhythm of your voice.

Aikito lies down in the sand, eyes half closed.

When the song ends, the Lumignon glides up to you, almost shy, as if it has understood that the night can be gentle too.

choices.text: Welcome it gently

approche_calme.title: The Little Lumignon
approche_calme.narrator: What frightens us at first glance sometimes needs only a little patience.
approche_calme.text:
The creature finally draws near your hand, timid. Aikito stays lying quietly beside you, tail softly thumping the sand.

Its skin is soft and warm, and its light pulses like a little beating heart.

Around its neck, a spiral shell hangs from a braided strand of seaweed — like a necklace.

It lets out a small cry, gentler this time, and looks out to sea, then back at you.

*"It wants to show us something,"* Aikito murmurs.

choices.text: Look more closely at the shell
Look where it points, out to sea

indice_coquillage.title: The Shell Necklace
indice_coquillage.narrator: A small clue is sometimes enough to change a whole night.
indice_coquillage.text:
The shell bears a spiral carving, like the patterns you have seen etched into the old cliffs north of Cape Mist.

The creature trembles slightly — not from fear, but from cold. It has been alone too long.

Aikito sniffs the shell carefully, then lifts his head toward the distant cliffs.

You understand: it is not some monster washed ashore by chance.

It is looking for its family, and it got lost along the way.

choices.text: Go ask the old fisherman at the harbor for advice
Follow the cliff path directly

vieux_pecheur.title: Mounec's Legend
vieux_pecheur.narrator: Stories we think are made up sometimes hide a grain of truth.
vieux_pecheur.text:
Old fisherman Mounec puts away his nets by the glow of a lamp. Aikito sits politely in front of him, which makes him smile.

When you describe the creature, his face lights up.

*"A Lumignon... I haven't seen one in thirty years. Their family lives in a cave beneath the northern cliffs. They only come out on moonless nights, and only to search for a little one who has wandered off."*

He hands you an oil lantern.

*"Go gently. The dark out there can seem frightening. But it is never empty."*

choices.text: Take the lantern and head for the cliffs
Ask Mounec why Lumignons are afraid of the dark

legende_noir.title: The Fear of the Depths
legende_noir.narrator: Understanding a fear does not make it vanish. But sometimes it grows smaller.
legende_noir.text:
Mounec thinks for a long while as he coils his nets.

*"Lumignons are born with their own light. In total darkness, they sometimes forget they are still shining. Then they believe they have disappeared."*

He hands you the lantern.

*"Show them they are not alone. That is all we can do."*

choices.text: Set off for the cliffs, lantern in hand

sentier_falaises.title: The Cliff Path
sentier_falaises.narrator: The darkest path is often the one that leads somewhere.
sentier_falaises.text:
The trail climbs between the rocks. Aikito leads the way, nose to the ground, as if following an invisible scent.

The Lumignon glides beside you over the puddles, its light brightening just enough of the path.

The wind blows hard. Below, waves crash against the stone.

Then, around a bend, you spot a dark opening in the cliff — a cave, silent.

The Lumignon stops short, hesitating before the black entrance. Even Aikito does not bark.

He looks at you, as if to ask: *are you coming with me?*

choices.text: Enter the cave with the Lumignon
Stay at the entrance and call with the lantern

appel_lanterne.title: A Signal in the Dark
appel_lanterne.narrator: You can help someone even without facing everything in their place.
appel_lanterne.text:
You stay at the entrance and swing the lantern gently, in rhythm, like the lighthouse signal.

Long. Short. Short.

Aikito sits right beside you, not making a sound, as if standing guard.

The Lumignon hesitates, then moves on alone into the dark, reassured by the light still shining behind it.

Deep in the cave, other blue-green glows light up, one by one, like stars waking.

Joyful cries echo against the rock.

choices.text: Wait at the entrance, lantern raised
Peek cautiously inside

aperçu_grotte.title: A Glimpse into the Darkness
aperçu_grotte.narrator: Looking into the dark without going in is sometimes the right balance between fear and courage.
aperçu_grotte.text:
You step forward just enough to see inside.

Blue-green glows dance at the back, like fireflies beneath the sea.

The Lumignon darts toward them with a joyful cry.

Aikito wags his tail without going in.

*"We don't need to go any farther. We've already helped."*

You stay at the entrance, lantern raised, until familiar shapes surround it.

choices.text: Head back down to the lighthouse, heart light

entree_grotte.title: In the Dark, Together
entree_grotte.narrator: Courage is not never being afraid. It is moving forward anyway, beside someone.
entree_grotte.text:
You take a deep breath and step into the cave, lantern raised before you.

Aikito trots just behind your heels, closer than usual.

The Lumignon stays right beside you, its light pressed to your shadow.

The darkness is thick, and the sound of the waves echoes strangely.

Then, around a corridor of stone, the cave opens into an immense cavern.

It is filled with blue-green glows dancing softly against the walls.

choices.text: Move toward the lights at the back
Call softly to announce your presence

appel_dans_grotte.title: A Voice in the Cavern
appel_dans_grotte.narrator: Announcing your presence gives others the choice not to be afraid of you.
appel_dans_grotte.text:
"We are friends," you say softly.

Your voice bounces off the stone, then settles.

The glows at the back pulse in answer, like a chord.

The Lumignon speeds up, reassured by your call.

When you enter the great cavern, the creatures do not flee. They draw closer, curious, almost smiling in their light.

choices.text: Join them by the pool

fin_reunion.title: The Lumignons of the Cave
fin_reunion.narrator: What seemed frightening sometimes hides only someone who needs help.
fin_reunion.text:
Dozens of creatures like the Lumignon swim around you in a pool of clear water, their light pulsing gently.

Two of them, larger, rush toward your little companion with cries of joy.

Its family.

Aikito barks once, happily, then sits very properly against your leg.

The Lumignon nestles against its own, then turns toward the two of you one last time, its antennae blinking softly — a true thank you.

As you head back to the lighthouse, you understand: what had frightened you so much that night was only a little lost being, simply trying to find its way back to those it loved.

fin_lumiere.title: The Light That Guides
fin_lumiere.narrator: You do not need to face everything to help — sometimes, holding the light is enough.
fin_lumiere.text:
You do not see the inside of the cave, but you hear joyful cries echoing against the rock.

Aikito presses his head against your leg, ears pricked, listening.

The Lumignon comes out for a moment, surrounded by two large glowing shapes — its family, come to fetch it.

It blinks one last time in your direction before diving back into the dark with them.

You make your way down to the lighthouse with Aikito, your lantern still warm in your hand.

You did not need to enter the dark to help someone find their way home. You only had to stay, and hold the light.
